name: 3D Game Bridge
summary: ReShade shader that routes a stereo pair (SBS or TAB input) to Simulated Reality and lightfield displays. Acts as a bridge between standard stereo game output and SR/Leia/Looking Glass display SDKs. Not a rendering method itself — converts and routes an existing stereo pair.
compatibility_notes: Requires an SR-compatible display (Acer SpatialLabs, Dimenco, Leia). Works downstream of any pipeline that produces SBS/TAB output — Geo-11, UEVR, native, or even SuperDepth3D.
